parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: The simultaneous component equations are inconsistent, so the lines do not intersect.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1 FT: express a general point of either line in components. M1: equate two component pairs and solve for λ or μ. A1: obtain a correct pair, e.g. λ=−1/5, μ=−3/5 (or the other printed pairs from different component choices). A1: show the third component is inconsistent, e.g. 16/5≠18/5, and conclude no intersection. [Total: 4]
